segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Karen. I wanted to confirm the final scope before I send the order form over. I have 48 standard seats and 6 manager seats, with implementation starting February 12. Is that still right?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, that's right. We may add two more manager seats later, but for the initial contract it's 54 total users.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. And the annual subscription comes to $38,640, plus the one-time implementation fee of $4,500. Billing would be annual upfront, net 30, unless finance needs something different.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Annual upfront is fine. Can you make sure the invoice references PO 7714? Our AP team will kick it back if that's missing.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, I'll add PO 7714 in the billing notes and on the order form. For go-live, we had March 25 as the target. That gives us about six weeks for kickoff, configuration, and admin training.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. We have a team meeting on March 28, so we'd like the managers trained before then, even if the rest of the team is still ramping.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. We'll schedule manager training the week of March 18. The standard user session can be recorded and shared, or we can do it live the following week.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Let's do live if we can. Also, on the contract term, this is a 12-month initial term with auto-renewal, correct?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct, 12 months, auto-renewal for another 12 unless either side gives 30 days notice before the renewal date. That's the standard language from legal.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. Send it over today if you can. I'll route it to procurement and try to get signature by Friday.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I'll send the order form and the implementation outline in the next hour, and I'll copy your procurement alias as well.
